scope: crates/sovereign-context deterministic retrieval routing and C0-C3 packet projection
minimal crates/sovereign-repo structural query extensions required for bounded symbol/dependency routing and reverse dependent neighborhoods

routing_contract.known_path: exact current path only; insufficient exact evidence never reports Satisfied
routing_contract.literal_error: bounded exact literal search, then bounded lexical fallback only after exact insufficiency
routing_contract.known_symbol: bounded exact symbol-name lookup plus bounded symbol index; no broad FTS/graph fanout
routing_contract.behavior: bounded lexical retrieval followed by at most one bounded structural anchor expansion after an explicit gap
routing_contract.impact: bounded outgoing plus reverse dependent/importer structural neighborhood as primary topology channel
routing_contract.diff: authoritative current Git diff -> exact current touched paths -> bounded touched-path symbols -> bounded outgoing/reverse dependency neighborhood
routing_contract.failure_history: optional normalized signature/repository/tool/symbol lookup before text fallback; no provider required until M4
routing_contract.fuzzy: bounded lexical first, at most one structural expansion, then typed semantic-unavailable marker in M2

production_adapter.source_authority: Repository truth remains in sovereign-repo. Context consumes current-source/fresh derived results and does not create a second repository authority.
production_adapter.freshness: Exact operations are direct current-source operations. Lexical/structural operations retain sovereign-repo preflight freshness, returned-row digest validation, complete post-query source-manifest revalidation, bounded refresh/retry, and fail-closed race behavior.
production_adapter.stale_rejected_semantics: RouteStep/trace use Option<usize>. Exact routes report known Some(0). Production lexical/symbol/structural report None because internal rejected-row counts are not exposed; telemetry must not reinterpret unknown as zero or re-query repository state.

bounded_structural_queries.definitions: COUNT plus SQL LIMIT; total candidate count remains truthful while at most 8 rows materialize
bounded_structural_queries.symbols_for_path: bounded current-path structural symbol query; total plus at most 8 rows materialized
bounded_structural_queries.outgoing_dependencies: COUNT plus SQL LIMIT; at most 12 rows materialized
bounded_structural_queries.dependent_importers: ordered scan counts all matching candidates but retains at most 12 matching rows; exact freshness validation remains in StructuralIndex
bounded_structural_queries.combined_neighborhood: bounded outgoing and inbound rows are deterministically sorted/deduplicated; final selected evidence capped at 12 with RouteBoundFact observed/limit/truncated

diff_route.authority: RepositoryRetrievalBackend::current_diff calls ExactRetriever::current_diff; caller supplies only repository_id.
diff_route.touched_paths: derived only from authoritative exact Git diff; parses --- a/ and +++ b/ patch headers plus rename from/to and copy from/to metadata, ignores /dev/null, then sorts/deduplicates before the deterministic cap
diff_route.bound_fact: Diff RouteStep records observed/limit/truncated for touched paths
diff_route.expansion_bound: At most 16 touched paths are admitted for exact/symbol/structural routing; symbol and structural rows are independently bounded.
diff_route.rename_copy_support: Pure tracked rename/copy metadata is treated as authoritative touched-path evidence even when Git emits no ---/+++ file headers; regression covers git mv to a path containing spaces.

trace_contract.identity_binding: trace_id binds intent, ordered route/outcome diagnostics, candidate/selected IDs, evidence-channel links, and every selected evidence source_digest/content_digest.
trace_contract.m2_t04_consumption: Per-route trace facts are sufficient for later telemetry without reconstructing repository/index state; unknown stale-rejection counts remain explicit.

context_packet.dedupe: ContextPlanner deduplicates by content_digest before bounded section selection.
context_packet.bounds: C0 remains mandatory; direct C1, routed C2/C3, tool evidence, tool schemas, and final serialization retain existing weak-model ceilings.
context_packet.history_default: no persistent history provider in M2
context_packet.semantic_default: semantic channel is an unavailable trace note only; no semantic retrieval occurs in M2

regression_evidence.context_full: 27/27 integration tests pass (9 packet + 18 routing); doc tests pass
regression_evidence.structural_filter: 1 structural unit + 10 structural integration tests pass
regression_evidence.repo_full: 2 unit + 5 baseline + 3 exact + 9 lexical + 10 structural integration tests pass; doc tests pass
